Coram : Amit Borkar, J.
Dated : June 20, 2023 P.C.:
1. Apprehending arrest in connection with C.R. No.245 of 2023 registered with
Wakad Police Station, District Pune for offences punishable under Section 420, 417,
464, 465, 468, 379 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, the applicant is seeking relief
under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973.

2.  The informant lodged a report alleging that he along with other co-owners are the owners of Survey No.4/9 admeasuring 41 gunthas and Survey No.4/16 admeasuring 56 gunthas situated at Mouje Thergaon.
On measurement of City Survey, it is revealed that the applicant by preparing forged document in connivance with unknown persons sold the property of the applicant and co- owners.

sentences.text: 3. Applicant's application under Section 438 of the Criminal Procedure Code, 1973 was rejected by the learned Sessions Judge by order dated 12 May 2023.

4. On perusal of the material on record and case papers produced by the investigating officer, it appears prima facie that no registered document has been executed by the applicant in favour of third parties.
The documents on record are notarised document.
Section 17-B of the Registration Act mandates a document evidencing creation of new right, title or interest only by a registered instrument.
Even a document containing delivery of possession needs to be stamped under Article 25 of the Bombay Stamp Act.

In absence of such documents, no right, title or interest could have been transferred by the applicant, with the result rights of owners of the property allegedly sold by the applicant are not affected.
The applicant has, therefore, made out a prima facie case for grant of relief.

( AMIT BORKAR, J.)
